what: Checkpoints behind the published Table 2 / Figure 1 cells. Inventory only: no checkpoint is committed to this repository.
path_note: checkpoint_relpath and config_relpath are relative to the run tree root on the cluster the runs were produced on; they are not paths inside this repository. run_dir names are legacy and are not run_ids: map at read time.
method_spelling_note: this manifest spells the method 'mrfp+'; the paper and the rest of the code use 'mrfp_plus' in code and run_ids and 'MRFP+' in prose.
not_included: SIB, CrossEarth, BSM and SAR checkpoints are not in this manifest; it covers the seven published LOCO baselines plus the within-city upper bounds.

method_families.what: Checkpoints behind the camera-ready CrossEarth, BSM, SAR and SIB rows. Inventory only: no checkpoint is committed to this repository.

roots.project_root: the run tree root on the cluster ($PROJECT_ROOT in the released scripts)
roots.scratch_root: the scratch working root ($ST_SCRATCH_ROOT in the released scripts)

SAR.why: SAR is test-time adaptation. The released driver trains nothing and writes no checkpoint; it adapts a parent checkpoint episodically and discards the adapted weights. The parent for the Table 2 SAR rows is the matched-450 MAMNet vanilla LOCO cell, listed in this file under the matched-450 entries.

method_families.absent_note: Entries with exists=false were probed and are genuinely not on disk. They are listed rather than omitted so the gap is visible.
method_families.probe_note: Probed following symlinks: data/{arch}/outputs/{run_dir} on the project root are symlinks into the scratch root, and a scan that does not follow them reports zero.
